1: Adults only. Verify your age once, before entering any chat.
2: No discrimination or slurs, whichever group is the target. Jokes are not a loophole.
3: Do not call for, threaten or glorify violence against anyone.
4: Stay civil and do not provoke. Report problems to staff instead of fighting in the chat.
5: Never share anybody's personal information without their consent. Ban on the first offense.
6: Post from your own account, never as a channel.
7: Do not ask for admin powers or special treatment. To help out, talk to staff.
8: Do not join and leave over and over. Three times and you are banned.
9: No advertising without staff approval, and every ad is approved on its own.
10: Do not flood the chat. Albums go up to 10 images, and only posting images is spam too.
11: Real-life NSFW goes behind a spoiler. Unsure? Ask an admin first.
12: Politics is allowed when it stays respectful. When an admin ends the discussion, it is over.
13: Nothing from the banned list, stickers included. Controlled content only behind a spoiler, with a content warning.
14: Do not share paysite content unless it is already public or the artist allows it.
15: AI-generated images are not allowed anywhere, spoilered or not.
16: Enough complaints against you can get you kicked, timed out or banned.
17: Rules are not applied retroactively, and a closed case stays closed.
18: Non-consensual content is banned. Consensual non-consent is allowed; depicted suffering draws the line.
19: A sustained pattern of conduct that harms the community can get you banned by two-thirds of the admins, even with no other rule broken. Never over opinions.
